method: Built-in image_gen__imagegen only; no API/CLI fallback, no image postprocessing.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent character sprite sheet for the King Down Chess Workshop.
Create a NEW character design called Crossbow Warden. The two attached images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: use their hand-painted fantasy board-game illustration style, crisp dark contour edges, broad readable forms, soft painted volume and subtly exaggerated anatomy. Do not copy either existing character's identity, costume, face or equipment. Do not copy their background.

Canvas and pairing: one landscape 1536 x 1024 image with a genuinely transparent background. Show exactly TWO complete full-body versions of the SAME Crossbow Warden side by side, ivory army version on the LEFT and charcoal army version on the RIGHT. Their identity, anatomy, pose, costume design, equipment, scale and slight three-quarter view facing RIGHT must match exactly; only the army palette changes. Each figure stays isolated in its own half, centered around x=384 and x=1152. Generous transparent margins and a clear central gutter. Highest point near y=120; both feet baselines near y=960. Keep the complete hat, crossbow arms, hands, legs, feet and every equipment edge inside the canvas.

Subject: an adult male crossbow guard with a tall rounded leather cap, a sturdy upright stance and clearly separated stable legs. He wears a padded short coat, a belt with a neat cluster of spare crossbow bolts, trousers and substantial boots. He holds a compact but BROAD HORIZONTAL MECHANICAL CROSSBOW at his waist with BOTH HANDS. Its horizontal bow arms, string, central stock and mechanical trigger form a clear crossbow silhouette. The bow arms remain clearly visible beyond his torso. It is neither a wrist-mounted weapon nor a drawn handbow. His head and body face slightly toward the right.

Palette: LEFT approximately 85 percent warm ivory/off-white, including the cap, padded coat, trousers, boots and most crossbow surfaces; RIGHT approximately 85 percent charcoal/dark cool gray over the same parts. Keep material shading and readable highlights. Small leather joins and a tiny muted metal accent may interrupt the main palette, but accents must remain tiny and subdued. Natural muted skin only on exposed face/hands.

Rendering: match the painted fantasy piece style of the references, readable as a small game piece; confident crisp dark outlines, broad softly painted planes, simplified material detail. No photorealistic materials, no realistic 3D render, no anime. Full-body character cutouts, no outline glow.

Strict exclusions: NO hood, long braid, mounted animal, crown, shield, red-haired female archer, plinth, pedestal, base, ground, contact shadow, cast shadow, environment, background gradients, smoke, effects, text, labels, watermark or painted checkerboard. The background must have real alpha transparency.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the Crossbow Warden sprite sheet to edit. Input images 2 and 3 are the established painted style references only.
Make ONE precise framing correction to image 1. Preserve the two characters exactly: same Crossbow Warden identity, bearded face, rounded cap, anatomy, identical paired pose, horizontal mechanical crossbow held in both hands, padded short coat, boots, equipment, crisp dark outlines, painterly shading, ivory LEFT and charcoal RIGHT palettes. Do not redesign, add, remove or recolor anything.

Keep the 1536 x 1024 landscape canvas. Scale EACH COMPLETE character plus ALL of its equipment down uniformly to roughly 87 percent of its current height. Position the full bounding box of the LEFT figure centrally inside x=90..678, and the RIGHT figure centrally inside x=858..1446. Put each figure's cap top at about y=120 and boot baseline at about y=960. All crossbow tips, feet and caps must be complete. Preserve exactly matching paired scale and same slight three-quarter facing RIGHT. Leave a generous transparent central gutter at x=720..816 and visible transparent outer, top and bottom margins.

The output must have genuine clean alpha transparency outside the two cutout figures, including all empty spaces between arms, legs and crossbow components. No background, no glow/gradient, no floor, no base or plinth, no ground/contact/cast shadow, no text/labels or checkerboard. This is only a size and placement correction; preserve the painted artwork.

The lantern must remain separate and legible against transparent space, not overlap the head.
